anchors.thesis: RB0 sits just below both moving averages after a flat 5-day change, with conflicting macro impulses and FOMC due within a week; no tradable B-arm edge exists yet.
anchors.driver: Event-calendar wait (FOMC 2026-06-17) and macro/sector disagreement rather than any single price driver.
anchors.rationale: Price alone: close 3156 is below ma20 3174.1 and ma60 3166.4 but chg5 is only -0.03%, so a v3-style trend signal is absent. Macro: DXY +0.27% and DR007 +6.89% are USD/liquidity headwinds for black, while US10Y -0.45% and a firmer CNH (USDCNH -0.20%) offset them, hence macroBias conflict and no macro-support claim. Sector: ret1d -0.21%, ret5d -0.84% and breadth5d 0.2 are weak, but ret20d +1.02% and coherence 0.89 keep the medium-term structure intact, so sectorBias neutral. Events: china_cpi_ppi just passed verified and nextScheduled fomc on 06-17 makes eventRisk high. The context turns a flat price tape into a watch rather than a trade. C臂FinCoT适配：同锚点FinCoT方向neutral（conflict_unresolved），方向一致 finCotAlignment=aligned；采纳 q1 宏观互斥与 q3 赔率中性判断，维持 watch。
anchors.invalidationReason: Not applicable for neutral; the watch would be revisited after FOMC and a fresh sector breadth reading.

anchors.thesis: Downtrend is in place below both moving averages and is reinforced by a stronger dollar, weaker CNH, a crashing energy complex and soft black-sector breadth; short a continuation break.
anchors.driver: USD strength and oil/energy weakness plus negative black-sector breadth, with FOMC now behind the market.
anchors.rationale: Price alone: close 3131 below ma20 3164.8 and ma60 3168.6 with chg5 -0.79% and volRatio 1.27 already suggests sellers are active. Macro adds agreement rather than offset: DXY +1.10% and USDCNH +0.21% are dollar-tight headwinds for commodities, and SC0 -12.64% signals commodity-complex risk-off, so macroBias bearish. Sector: ret1d -1.04%, ret5d -1.02% and breadth5d 0.2 confirm bearish sectorBias; ret20d +2.15% is the only offset. Events: FOMC is now past (verified) and china_lpr on 06-22 is a known schedule, so eventRisk medium, acceptable for execution. Context keeps the price-only short but tightens the trigger to 0.6 ATR to avoid chasing the initial break. C臂FinCoT适配：同锚点FinCoT方向bearish，方向一致 finCotAlignment=aligned；采纳 q1 美元/商品驱动与 q3 空头赔率判断，0.6 ATR 突破执行。
anchors.invalidationReason: A close back above 3165 (ma20/ma60 confluence) would invalidate the short thesis.

anchors.thesis: The black sector has now joined the price trend (sector ret20d negative), the dollar keeps climbing and the energy complex keeps sliding; stay short continuation.
anchors.driver: Sector rollover plus persistent dollar strength; domestic PMI is the only nearby known event.
anchors.rationale: Price alone: close 3093, ma20 3150.8, ma60 3166.2, chg5 -1.21% and volRatio 1.17 is a clean bear trend. Macro adds bearish weight: DXY +0.60% and USDCNH +0.33% are commodity headwinds, and SC0 -8.12% shows the commodity complex still deflating; US10Y -1.79% is the one supportive offset but not enough to flip macroBias. Sector: ret5d -1.96%, ret20d -2.20% (now negative) and breadth5d 0.4 make sectorBias bearish, with the 06-26 ret1d +0.19% treated as a one-day bounce inside a down move. Events: china_pmi on 06-30 is a known scheduled release, so eventRisk medium; the plan stays executable but uses a wider 1.8 ATR stop to absorb pre-PMI noise. Versus price alone, context upgrades conviction to high because sector and macro finally agree with the price trend. C臂FinCoT适配：同锚点FinCoT方向bearish（high），方向一致 finCotAlignment=aligned；采纳 q1 板块+美元共振与 q5 证伪条件，1.8 ATR 止损。
anchors.invalidationReason: A close back above 3136 (above the trigger zone and near the falling ma20) invalidates the continuation.

anchors.thesis: ATR contraction and conflicting macro forces put RB0 in a post-PMI holding pattern; no direction has enough evidence to act.
anchors.driver: Liquidity loosening and a softer dollar against higher yields and a still-falling oil complex.

The context flips a price-only bearish bias to neutral watch because macro and sector no longer confirm the down move. C臂FinCoT适配：同锚点FinCoT方向neutral（conflict_unresolved），方向一致 finCotAlignment=aligned；采纳 q1 宏观互斥与 q3 中性赔率，维持 watch。
anchors.invalidationReason: Not applicable for neutral; watch would be dropped if price closes back above ma20 with sector breadth above 0.6.

anchors.driver: Sector breadth stays weak and US10Y rises while the bounce lacks volume; oil's rebound is the main conflicting force.

anchors.thesis: Price broke back below ma20 and the sector is not participating, but back-to-back FOMC and PMI events within days argue against execution; keep the short plan on watch.
anchors.driver: Trend resumption in black-sector weakness, capped by event risk.

anchors.driver: Sector-wide breakdown (JM0 -8.09%, I0 -4.02%) after FOMC/PMI, with rebar closing near the 3000 shelf.

Context upgrades the breakdown into an executable short: the sector confirms what price alone shows and event uncertainty has cleared. anchors.driver: Sector breadth surge (0.8) and macro tailwind from a softer dollar, lower yields and looser DR007.

Events: china_cpi_ppi is scheduled 08-10 with verified=false/schedule, a calendar expectation only, so eventRisk medium; the plan stays executable but uses a 0.7 ATR breakout trigger to require confirmation. Context flips a flat price tape to a bullish plan because macro and sector both support while RB0 itself lags. anchors.thesis: Sector momentum (ret20d positive, JM0 +19.57%) argues the 3000 shelf is a base; RB0 is still below ma20, so buy a shallow pullback toward 3020 rather than chase.
anchors.driver: Black-sector breadth and momentum pulling RB0 toward its falling ma20.
